chunks.text: Hello guys, welcome back to my channel Indian Kitchen. Today I am going to make Chicken Kebab. Raw Kebab If you like the recipe, please like and subscribe to my channel. We have washed and strained 300 gm of chicken. We have removed all the water from it. We have added some ginger garlic paste and washed it. We have also grinded it in a mixer. We have also added some green chilies and ginger garlic paste. We have ground it without water. We will mix all these ingredients in it. We will also add some powder spices. We will mix it. We will add some red chili powder according to taste. We will add 1 tsp, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp coriander powder, 1 tsp chaat masala. We have added some salt according to taste. Because chaat masala also has salt. We will mix all these spices in it. We have chopped 1 onion finely. We have not squeezed any water in it. We will add some chopped green chilies and coriander leaves. We will also add 1 egg. This will give a nice shape to the kebab. It will not break. I have made a powder of roasted chickpeas. We will add it. If you don't have a mixer, you can use a hand blender. We will also add some water. We will also add some water. We will also add some water. We will also add some water. We will also add some water. We will also add some water. If you don't have a mixer, you can use bread crumbs. You can also add corn flour. We are adding 1 tsp ghee. If you don't have ghee, you can add oil. Because the chicken is very dry. So it will be soft from inside. We will mix all these things well. We will mix all things well for 4 to 5 minutes We will keep it overnight to marinate We will keep it overnight to marinate But 10 to 15 minutes is enough for all these things. 20 minutes later 20 minutes later 20 minutes later Now we will give it a shape. We will make small or big parathas as per our choice We will make small patties Let's make one more We will make small ones as they are crispy So it is better to make big ones We will make small ones We have heated the oil We will turn the flame to medium We will put the patties in the oil We should not keep the flame high Because the raw mince should be cooked I had also added mint leaves But I forgot to tell you We have turned the flame to low We have kept the pan on the stove So that the patties are cooked inside We will take them out We will make more patties in the same way Our chicken kabab is ready We have made mint chutney We have made bullet kabab I have uploaded it on my channel I have told you how to make this chutney Subscribe to my channel
